title: From Speech to steadier practice
subtitle: A deliberate path through speech
description: Guru makes speech answer to praise, restraint, and truthfulness. This path starts with short guidance, opens the topic fully, and then stays long enough with Gurbani to change pace.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Speak what carries honor, not just what releases heat.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Restraint is sometimes the most truthful form of speech.
